title: SB2532 (2020 Regular): Honorably retired judges; may obtain an enhanced concealed carry license for life.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Mississippi) (gun-policy Stage 5, Mississippi); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (Introduced; official copy, https://billstatus.ls.state.ms.us/documents/2020/html/SB/2500-2599/SB2532IN.htm)
provenance.note: Introduced text as filed; no passage vote recorded. Only marked additions are the (i)/(ii) designators and judge clause; the rest of the long § 45-9-101 is unchanged existing law and is not quoted. Ordering as printed: the fee-exemption clause for officers/veterans is existing text now labeled (i).

operative_text: Section 1 (Miss. Code § 45-9-101): (5) (c) (i) Honorably retired law enforcement officers, disabled veterans and active duty members of the Armed Forces of the United States shall be exempt from the payment of the license fee; (ii) Judges who are listed in Section 97-37-7 as being exempt from this section and who are retired from the bench in good standing may obtain an instructor-certified concealed weapon license under this section by complying with this section and with the requirements of Section 97-37-7. The honorably retired judge is thereafter exempt from any additional payment of fees under this section for life;
